description: Live P1 evidence on the clarify-rate-limit seed (API rate limiting whose limit, window, caller identity, refusal response, exemptions and counter store are open): /pan:discuss-phase 1 with a real model and a scripted user that answers every question, then count the questions the session asked.
why: Program P1's evidence gate: at most five clarifying questions per questioning session, on three live seeds (references/questioning.md <question_budget>). The tier-0 discuss-phase-scripted-user scenario proves the plumbing with a scripted model; only a real model shows whether the budget holds. Run the three together with --tier 2 and an approved --max-usd.
